$comment: EXP-1280 custom plan mode ×4 (web packages/ui session-thread-view.tsx + ask-card.tsx, desktop crates/ui thread_screen.rs + ask_dock.rs + steer_viewer.rs, iOS ThreadConversation.swift + AskDock.swift, Android ThreadParts.kt + AskDock.kt; device mirror crates/domain/src/plan_card.rs). Plan mode is Exponential's, not the CLI's: a session in plan mode (sessions.plan_mode) researches, may draft UI on its branch to picture it, then posts ONE rich card with `exponential_plan_propose({plan, pictures?, questions?, surface?})` as the last call of its turn and stops (needs_input; Needs you). `exponential_sessions_ask({question, options, multi?, custom?, pictures?, surface?})` posts the same kind of card as ONE question outside a plan. The card = the existing `plan` / `question` message card with ADDITIVE fields (an old client still renders the markdown + the decision): `plan` GFM may embed pictures (`![alt](/api/attachments/{id})`; until an upload lands `![alt](upload:<label>)`, which renders NOTHING); `pictures` [{label, attachmentId|null, width, height, caption?}] = the upload namespace (the tool answers one upload line per label, same curl as the Guide's; the upload route fills attachmentId/width/height and rewrites `upload:<label>` in the markdown: `resolveUpload`); `questions` [{id, prompt, multi, custom, options:[{label, description?, picture?: <label>}]}] = the form; `surface` {root, data?} = an Exponential UI core surface rendered inline by the real renderer (no transport, `set` only, media = /api/attachments + https); the answer = `decision` + `fresh` + `feedback` + `answers` {questionId: labels[]} + `surfaceData` (the surface's data model at answer time), stamped IN the card by `sessions.answer` (also flips sessions.plan_mode=false on approval; the device delivers `answerText` as the agent's next turn, `fresh` = a fresh context prompted with it). A question card gains `multi`, `custom`, `optionPictures` (sidecar of picture LABELS parallel to `options`, null = none), `surface`, `answers` (labels) + `surfaceData`; `answer` stays the labels joined by `joiner` (compat). RENDER ×4: the card = AskCard header (ask-dock.json) + the markdown body (pictures inline, max body height per ask-dock) + the surface (full card width, its own frame) + one block per question: `prompt` (strong) + `chooseOne`/`chooseAny` caption + the options as THE option rows (every option without a picture: `optionRows(options) = list`, the question card's rows: label + description, a check glyph when picked) or as TILES (`tiles` once ANY option has a picture: `tiles.columns` per row (phones `tiles.phoneColumns`), each tile = picture (`pictureAspect` w/h, cover, `radius`) over label + description, picked = `selectedRing` px accent ring; a tile without a picture keeps the frame with the placeholder glyph) + `custom` = the free-text row `copy.custom`; then the decision row = ask-dock.json `planOptions` (a question card: the Answer button) + the feedback field. `approveDisabled(card, answers)` = a required answer missing (`copy.answerIssues.missing` under the button); rejecting never needs answers. ANSWERED = closed: picked options stay highlighted, the rest inert, the decision label (ask-dock `planDecisionLabel`) + feedback shown. Model = pure `plan-card.ts` (TS reference): every mirror replays `answerTextCases` (the WHOLE string), `answerIssueCases`, `resolveUploadCases` (the WHOLE card), `optionRowsCases`, `pictureForCases`.
